 Sydney Thunder have named a 13-player squad to take on the Melbourne Renegades tomorrow evening at Junction Oval in their first match of Weber WBBL|12.
 The squad will once again be led by Phoebe Litchfield, who enters her third season as captain.   
 Nadine de Klerk and Nicola Hancock are in line to make their club debuts after crossing from the Brisbane Heat, while Hannah Darlington could make her long-awaited return in lime green after missing the last two seasons due to knee injuries.   
 Sydney Thunder Head Coach, Lisa Keightley, said:    
 "We’re looking forward to getting started and playing some exciting cricket.   
 "We've got a lot of match winners, and a lot of options with both bat and ball to be able to put pressure on teams throughout both innings.   
 "The Renegades have got a great, dynamic list so it will be a great hit out to start the competition."   
 Sydney Thunder squad v Melbourne Renegades   
 Phoebe Litchfield (C) (18)  
 Sam Bates (34)  
 Lauren Bell (63)  
 Hannah Darlington (25)  
 Nadine de Klerk (32)  
 Lucy Finn (81)  
 Hasrat Gill (9)  
 Nicola Hancock (44)  
 Laura Harris (24)  
 Heather Knight (5)  
 Anika Learoyd (4)  
 Georgia Voll (13)  
 Tahlia Wilson (21)   
 Jemma Barsby will not travel with the squad due to personal reasons but will be available to make her club debut on Sunday, November 1 at Drummoyne Oval.
